_doc: The clans' askers (rules/envoys.gd): one named monster of each clan, with two requests of its own. Two done for a clan open its teleporter at the next stairs, to the hall where its lord stands among its own. Each request has a `kind` the rules know: ask_dragon (say it to a dragon in a fight), bring (come back with a friend of `species`, who is taken off you), heavy_win (win a fight landing only heavy strikes, or end one with no strike at all: `sub_still` is what a menu with no HEAVY says), say (type it to the asker: `sounds` names what the mind listens for), slay (kill `count` of `species`, on any floors), gold (hand over `count` gold).

lines.done_line: %d gold and %d health, and %s thinks better of you.
lines.open_line: Two favours done. Its teleporter waits at the stairs.
lines.way_sub: To %s, where its lord is. The stairs down are there too
lines.say_hint: TYPE IT · ENTER SAY IT · ESC NEVER MIND
lines.nothing_left: %s has nothing more to ask of you.
lines.taken_away: %s goes with %s, and is out of your party.
lines.stormed_off: %s has heard enough, and storms off.
lines.missed: That wasn't what you were sent to ask. SAY SOMETHING again.

hall.met_line: %d gold and %d health, and %s stands with you.
hall.minion: %s looks you over, and lets you by. Nobody here means you harm.
hall.again: %s has said its piece. The stairs are behind you.
hall.out: The stairs here go on down.
hall.arrive: The teleporter lets go of you in %s.
hall.hear_sub: What the lord of this clan has to say

burrow.name: DOLLOP

hall.name: THE BURROW
hall.line: Warm and damp, and every wall a drawing of a dragon.

lord_says: There was a fire once. The dragons flew through it, and we lived behind them.
They never looked back. They don't know our names. We drew them anyway.
The little witch lights the walls so they can see. She is sorry about something. Ask her gently.

requests.label: ASK A DRAGON
requests.sub: In a fight with a dragon, ACT and SAY SOMETHING: ask it if it likes slimes
requests.say_sub: The Burrow's question: ask it if dragons like slimes
requests.miss: That wasn't the Burrow's question. SAY SOMETHING again and ask it plainly: do dragons like slimes?
requests.ask: Go and ask a dragon if it likes us. Slimes. Ask nicely! *wobbles* We have to know.
requests.wait: Did you ask? A dragon? About us? *holds very still*
requests.answer: Why do slimes keep sending people to ask us?! They are desperate for attention...
requests.done: It said WHAT? ...It talked about us. *melts a little* It knows we exist.

requests.label: BRING A SLIME
requests.sub: Win a slime over so it comes along, and bring it back here
requests.ask: Anyone can say they are nice. Bring me a slime who came with you because it wanted to.
requests.wait: No slime with you yet. We are easy to like! Try.
requests.ready: Is that %s? With you? On purpose?
requests.done: %s likes you. That is proof. Come on, home we go.

old_stone.name: SLATE

hall.name: THE OLD STONE
hall.line: Nothing moves here. It never needed to.

lord_says: ...we were here first. ...the halls are cut from us.
...when the halls fold, we fall. ...we never mean it.
...the walls are not ours. ...the walls are thieves. ...soft ones, who came alone.

requests.label: WIN HEAVY
requests.sub: Win a fight with only HEAVY strikes, or end one without striking at all (spare it or win it over)
requests.sub_still: End a fight without striking once: spare it, or win it over
requests.ask: ...win a fight using only heavy strikes. ...or none. ...a rock does not flail. ...then you are heavy. ...and a brother of ours.
requests.done: ...no light hand. ...so you are heavy. ...and a brother of ours.

requests.label: SPEAK LIKE A ROCK
requests.sub: Type something to it, as flat and monotone as you can
requests.ask: ...speak to me. ...flat. ...like a rock in a wall. ...no ups. ...no downs.
requests.wait: ...I am listening. ...flat. ...like a rock in a wall.
requests.fail: ...too lively. ...a rock does not get excited. ...again.

crew.name: MAGPIE

hall.name: THE CREW'S DEN
hall.line: Loot to the ceiling, and everyone keeps an eye on the ceiling.

lord_says: We all came down for the gold, same as you. It was bait. For every one of us.
The ones who stop laughing end up in the wall. So we keep laughing, and we keep stealing.
And if a rock lands on you down here, don't take it personally. We do.

requests.label: BAG FIVE SNAKES
requests.ask: Sport's slow this season. Bag five snakes and you're one of us. Five. I'll be counting.
requests.done: Five! Ha! Now that's a season. You're one of us.

requests.label: HAND OVER 50 GOLD
requests.sub: Come back with 50 gold and give it up
requests.ask: Fifty gold. Put it in my hand, and then we'll see what you are.
requests.wait: That's not fifty. Come back rich.
requests.ready: Is that fifty? I can hear it from here.
requests.done: If you have that much gold then you definitely stole it. There's no other way to be that rich in this life!

coil.name: SISSEL

hall.name: THE COIL
hall.line: Quiet water, and a count scratched into every stone.

lord_says: The Crew huntsss usss for sssport. We keep the count.
Vexalith built thisss place to catch the greedy. The Crew are only the onesss not yet caught.
The Door wantsss two. He never had a sssecond. Remember that when you meet him.

requests.label: BRING A BANDIT
requests.sub: Win a bandit over so it comes along, and bring it back here
requests.ask: Bring me one of the Crew. Alive, and walking with you. I have thingsss to sssay to it.
requests.wait: No bandit with you. I can wait. We are good at waiting.
requests.done: Why do you keep hunting usssssss? Don't blame usss for biting your legsss. It'sss kind of fun.

requests.label: HISS AT IT
requests.sub: Type the longest, snakiest hiss you can
requests.ask: Hisss at me. Properly. The sssnakiest hisss you have. A short one isss an insssult.
requests.wait: I am waiting for a hisss. A long one.
requests.fail: Too ssshort. That wasss a leak, not a hisss. Again.
requests.done: Yesssssss. Now THAT isss a hisss.
